page_title: ATM 3-0 SEV | Atletico Madrid v Sevilla 01/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Sevilla.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' 3 - 0 Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and drills a shot into the bottom left corner in trademark fashion.
89' Great teamplay by Sevilla as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
86' Here is a change. Julian Alvarez is going off and Diego Simeone gives the last tactical orders to Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid).
86' Substitution. Giuliano Simeone walks off the pitch and Giacomo Raspadori (Atl. Madrid) comes on as a substitute.

83' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.

82' Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sevilla.
79' Isaac Romero goes off the pitch and Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) comes on.
79' Matias Almeyda has decided to substitute Peque and he is replaced by Alfonso Gonzalez (Sevilla).
77' The expression of the referee Francisco Maeso is crystal clear. This behaviour won't be tolerated. Odysseas Vlachodimos (Sevilla) is shown a yellow card.

77' 2 - 0 Goal! Giuliano Simeone displays great vision and sends a pass to Thiago Almada (Atl. Madrid), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball inside the left post. The score is 2:0.
74' The manager makes a subsitution with Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) coming on for Alex Baena.
73' Peque (Sevilla) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

73' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the bottom left corner, but Jan Oblak was alert and made a comfortable save. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Sevilla.
72' Matias Almeyda has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Akor Adams (Sevilla) replacing Juanlu Sanchez.
71' David Hancko (Atl. Madrid) is able to continue to play.
70' David Hancko (Atl. Madrid) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
69' Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) comes onto the pitch after Nicolas Gonzalez signals to the bench that he cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
68' Alexander Sorloth comes off the pitch to be replaced by Thiago Almada (Atl. Madrid).
68' An attempted cross from Gabriel Suazo (Sevilla) is cleared.
67' Sevilla enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
64' 1 - 0 Goal! Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Odysseas Vlachodimos into the bottom left corner.
64' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
63' Tanguy Nianzou (Sevilla) is yellow-carded.
63' Here comes the VAR decision. YES, it's a penalty!
62' Referee Francisco Maeso makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
60' Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
60' Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. The referee signals a corner kick to Atl. Madrid.
59' Odysseas Vlachodimos comes off his line to intercept the corner from Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid).
59' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
57' The resulting corner from Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) comes to nothing.
56' A pass by Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.

56' Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) brings his opponent down. Francisco Maeso has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Atl. Madrid win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
54' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) is given a yellow card.
54' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Isaac Romero (Sevilla). Francisco Maeso saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. A free kick to Atl. Madrid.

53' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) times his run well and connects with a cross on the edge of the six-yard box, but can't keep the ball down and it flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
52' Peque (Sevilla) takes a short corner kick.

51' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) is first to the lofted pass but plants a header miles over the bar from close in. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sevilla.
49' A pass by Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
48' Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Francisco Maeso signals. Atl. Madrid get a free kick.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Cesar Azpilicueta (Sevilla) is replaced by Tanguy Nianzou.
46' Matias Almeyda makes a switch. Nemanja Gudelj is coming on in place of Batista Mendy (Sevilla) at the start of the second period.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.

45+3' Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) fires the ball towards goal from just outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar after coming very close to hitting the roof of the net. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
45' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.

44' He should have scored! Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot aimed inside the right post is pretty weak and Odysseas Vlachodimos makes an easy save.
44' A cross from a corner kick by Sevilla is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
43' Gabriel Suazo (Sevilla) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
42' Matteo Ruggeri (Atl. Madrid) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Francisco Maeso blows his whistle for a foul. Sevilla will take a free kick near the side line.
40' Atl. Madrid seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
37' Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) squanders a big chance. He takes a rebound inside the box and smashes the ball against the right post!
36' Matteo Ruggeri (Atl. Madrid) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
34' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by David Hancko (Atl. Madrid) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
34' The Atl. Madrid players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
32' Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Francisco Maeso blows his whistle for a foul.
30' Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
30' A lofted cross from Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.

29' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the middle of the goal. However, Odysseas Vlachodimos anticipates the shot and makes a decent save.
24' Gabriel Suazo (Sevilla) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
23' Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. The referee points to the corner flag and Sevilla will take a corner.
23' The Sevilla players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
19' The resulting corner from Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) is cleared.
17' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
15' Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
15' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid have been awarded a corner kick.
14' Sevilla are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
11' Odysseas Vlachodimos leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid).
8' Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sevilla.
7' Francisco Maeso blows his whistle for a foul after Marcao (Sevilla) hacks down one of his opponents. Atl. Madrid win a free kick.
5' Chance! Isaac Romero (Sevilla) took a nice pass in his stride in the box, but scuffed his shot just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
4' The Sevilla players are exchanging some short passes.
